parts.text: Edit this image: on the vest panel on the LEFT side of the picture, replace all the existing pins with exactly EIGHT enamel slasher-themed pins, each a different design, neatly spaced in two columns: 1 a white skull, 2 an orange fire flame, 3 a bloody knife, 4 an axe, 5 a glass poison vial with green liquid, 6 a bloodshot eyeball, 7 a red anatomical heart, 8 a red blood drop. No other pins, no hockey mask pin, no stars, no text. The other vest panel (right side of picture) stays plain with no pins. Keep the man, cap, ball, mask, gold axe, pose and background exactly the same.
